crossRefs.note: She said to them, “Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
When he came, behold, Eli was sitting on his seat by the road watching, for his heart trembled for God’s ark. When the…
When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.
Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for…
We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!
Have you utterly rejected Judah? Has your soul loathed Zion? Why have you struck us, and there is no healing for us? We…
For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
I form the light and create darkness. I make peace and create calamity. I am Yahweh, who does all these things.
Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and Yahweh hasn’t…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from Yahweh to the gate of Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: For the dwellers of Maroth pined for good, but calamity came down from the LORD, even to the gate of Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the LORD unto the gate of Jerusalem.
translations.asv: For the inhabitant of Maroth waiteth anxiously for good, because evil is come down from Jehovah unto the gate of Jerusalem.
